Welcome to TROVE's documentation!
=================================

**TROVE** (the Tool for Rapid Object Vetting and Examination) is a web application and application programming interface (API) 
designed for real-time object vetting of new transients for optimizing follow-up of poorly localized astronomical events.

Quickstart
----------

1. Navigate to https://datatrove.as.arizona.edu
2. Login or register for an account (Note that registration may take 1-2 days to be approved)
3. See GW events by clicking the "Events" → "Gravitational Waves" tab in the navigation bar at the top of the website.
4. Click on any of the GW event names to navigate to an "Event Candidate" page that contains a ranked list of scores 
   for all event candidates associated with a particular event.
5. From the "Event Candidate" page, click on individual targets to see more details.
6. See a full list of electromagnetic (EM) candidate counterparts by clicking the "EM Candidates" → "All Candidates" tab in the navigation bar at the top of the website.
